_readme: Room graph for the explorable world (PLAN §5.4). Keys are room paths under /world/. A door's `to` is another room path, or an absolute site URL. `content` binds a room to a project or note from /content. Backdrop keys map to files in public/worlds (see lib/worlds.ts); omit to use the side's default. Adding a room = adding an entry here — no code.
